author: reek
body: A self tail-recursive loop whose third argument is `s.v + 1`, a field access plus a literal. The tail-call planner classes that argument as DIRECT, because is-direct-tail-binop accepts any left operand at all when the right is a small integer literal and the operator is add or sub. But tco-arg-reads walks only names, so it reports that argument as reading no parameters at all.

author: reek
body: It reads one. `s` is parameter two, and the second argument is a plain local, so the planner is free to write parameter two first -- and then the field access reads the value that was just overwritten.
